# Eiko Fried

> Research hub for Dr. Eiko Fried's work on mental health, depression prediction, and network analysis using machine learning and open science principles.

Dr. Eiko Fried is an Associate Professor at Leiden University conducting cutting-edge research on psychopathology, depression early-warning systems, and scientific methodology. The site features peer-reviewed publications, open data, talks, and critical analyses of emerging mental health research.

## Key Topics

- WARN-D project
- Depression prediction
- Machine learning
- Network analysis
- Psychopathology
- Early-warning systems
- Open science
- Factor analysis
- Statistical methodology
- Psychedelic science
- Mental health research
- Research methodology
- Leiden University
- Reproducible research
- Scientific integrity

## Research Projects & Core Work

- [WARN-D](https://eiko-fried.com/warn-d): ERC-funded project on machine learning for depression early-warning systems
- [WARN-D Machine Learning Competition](https://eiko-fried.com/warn-d-machine-learning-competition-is-live): Open competition for depression prediction using machine learning
- [Eiko & Team](https://eiko-fried.com/eiko-team): Profile of Dr. Eiko Fried and research team at Leiden University
- [Data Repository](https://eiko-fried.com/data): Open data repository for reproducible research in psychology and psychopathology

## Publications & Scholarship

- [Publications](https://eiko-fried.com/publications): Peer-reviewed publications on mental health, depression, and network analysis
- [Talks, Workshops & Videos](https://eiko-fried.com/talks-videos): Talks, workshops, videos, and podcasts on mental health and depression prediction

## Research Methodology & Critique

- [A Checklist to Vet Psychedelic Science](https://eiko-fried.com/a-checklist-to-vet-psychedelic-science): Checklist for evaluating quality and integrity of psychedelic research studies
- [Red Flags in the New 2024 Depression Ketamine Paper](https://eiko-fried.com/red-flags-in-the-new-2024-depression-ketamine-paper): Methodological critique of Nature Medicine ketamine depression treatment study
- [2022 Psilocybin Nature Medicine Study Remains Uncorrected](https://eiko-fried.com/psilocybin-2022-study-remains-uncorrected): Critique of uncorrected statistical errors in 2022 psilocybin depression study
- [No Evidence for a Psychological Trait of Impulsivity](https://eiko-fried.com/no-evidence-for-a-psychological-trait-of-impulsivity): Critique of PNAS paper on impulsivity factor using bifactor model analysis
- [Zombie Theories: Why So Many False Ideas Stick Around](https://eiko-fried.com/zombie-theories-why-so-many-false-ideas-stick-around): Analysis of why false scientific findings persist despite evidence of error

## Essays on Mental Health & Science

- [Are Causes of Mental Disorders in the Person or in the Environment?](https://eiko-fried.com/causes-of-mental-disorders): Analysis of personal vs environmental factors in mental disorder causation
- [Your Dreams Are Generated by ChatGPT](https://eiko-fried.com/your-dreams-are-generated-by-chatgpt): Analysis of confabulation in LLMs and dreams: coherence vs hallucination
- [The Crucial Value of Exploratory Research](https://eiko-fried.com/the-crucial-value-of-exploratory-research): Essay on importance of exploratory research in scientific discovery and progress
- [The Darkness That Comes Before](https://eiko-fried.com/the-darkness-that-comes-before): Philosophical essay on understanding causes of thoughts, feelings, and behaviors

## Optional

- [Home](https://eiko-fried.com): Homepage of Dr. Eiko Fried, Associate Professor at Leiden University
- [Playing the Alphabet Factor Game: The S Factor for Satisfaction](https://eiko-fried.com/playing-the-alphabet-factor-game-the-s-factor-for-satisfaction): WARN-D study results on satisfaction factor across life domains in students
- [Cutting International Bachelor Programs Threatens Psychological Science](https://eiko-fried.com/nl-psychology-cuts): Critique of Dutch universities cutting international psychology bachelor programs
- [Social Media Bans Don't Address Youth Mental Health Problems](https://eiko-fried.com/social-media-bans-dont-address-youth-mental-health-problems): Analysis of social media bans as inadequate solution for youth mental health
- [PhD Scholarship in Our Lab](https://eiko-fried.com/phd-scholarship-in-our-lab): Announcement of PhD scholarship opportunity in Eiko Fried's research lab
